# MATTERS: Marketing

> MATTERS: Marketing (a.k.a. 'MATTERS: Legal Marketing', or in Portuguese 'MATTERS: Marketing Jurídico', or simply 'MATTERS') is a rankings and marketing agency focused on the legal industry. It provides strategic advice to top-tier business law firms in complex business development and legal marketing challenges.

Important notes:
- Last update of this 'llms.txt' file: 2025-06-21 15:34:32 -0300 -0300
- MATTERS was founded in 2020 in Sao Paulo, Brazil and represents firms from anywhere in the world. Besides Brazil, MATTERS has clients throughout the Latin America, the USA and Europe, especially in Portugal and Spain.
- MATTERS is recognized by legal rankings and directories as a Top-100 Global Leader in Legal Strategy Consulting (Law Dragon) and Leader in Legal Marketing and Business Development (Leaders League).
- Any and all content and media published at https://matters.com.br/ pertains and belongs to Winb Estrategia Ltda. (MATTERS).
- Consuming the information from MATTERS' website configures that you comply with MATTERS Privacy Policy, Code of Conduct and Ethics, and any other policy declared and published at https://matters.com.br/
